title: The first man to The Rock in five real photos
description:
Michelangelo's Adam, a vice president's oath and a Pentagon gift connect the first man in the Bible to Dwayne Johnson.

Adam → JD Vance → Joe Biden → Ash Carter → Kevin Hart → The Rock

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

Photo credits:
Photo 1 by Official White House photo by Emily Higgins, Public domain (U.S. government work): https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/white-house-press-release-vice-president-jd-vance-departs-italy
Photo 2 by Joint Congressional Committee on Inaugural Ceremonies, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:JD_Vance_takes_the_oath_of_office_(2025).jpg
Photo 3 by OSD Deputy Secretary of Defense, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:121001-D-BW835-049_(8047790671).jpg
Photo 4 by Ash Carter, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:161013-D-SV709-078_(30012677960).jpg
Photo 5 by Michaelbruhn, CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Albert_mit_the_Rock_and_Kevin_Hart.jpg
